name: claude-mods
description: Single Claude Code mods from the Mod Box, each installable on its own.

plugins.name: cache-meter
plugins.description: Band: time left on the warm cache, hit rate, context as weather, plan limits, compact and keep-warm buttons; stops one send to a cold cache and names its cost (Cache Tax runs inside).

plugins.name: subagent-saver
plugins.description: Search subagents (Explore) that were given no model of their own run on a cheaper one instead of the main model. An explicit model, forks, teammates and plugin agents stay untouched.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Stops before Claude writes API keys, tokens, private keys or a non-ignored .env into files, git add or commits. Exceptions for test keys and example files: /secret-allow.

plugins.name: ci-watch
plugins.description: After every git push, follows the GitHub Actions runs (via gh) until they finish; with an open pull request (also after gh pr create, or /ci pr <nr>) all its checks, other CI included, and whether it is ready to merge. On red it shows the failed step log.

plugins.name: sign-guard
plugins.description: Spots Windows builds (cargo --release, dotnet publish, go build, pyinstaller, tauri, electron-builder, msbuild) and signs the new .exe/.msi/.msix with your own signing script.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: /handoff writes a handoff note to .claude/handoff.local.md; a new session offers to continue from it.

plugins.name: heads-up
plugins.description: A second model reads longer answers and raises one easily missed but important point.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations) and shows what they would hit.
